question: Why are neural networks so widely used in modern machine learning?
direct_answer: They are flexible function approximators that can learn useful representations from data.
expanded_answer: Neural networks can combine many learned transformations with nonlinearities, which makes them adaptable to images, text, audio, and structured data. This flexibility lets them support both end-to-end prediction and representation learning at scale.
key_points: Scales well with data and compute
common_wrong_ideas: They are popular only because they are trendy
They require handcrafted features to work
